answer: To stop Sybil swarms, nodes verify cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs before granting consensus rights. Registration costs scale superlinearly per identity: like a rising plume of smoke, quadratic staking drives adversary capital to its nadir with exponential capital exhaustion. Even if an attacker crafts a flawless sonnet to mimic human agents, the superlinear cost curve ensures attacking remains mathematically ruinous.
